name: @pdxui/responsive
description: PDX contract-test harness — validates PDX components/design system with @responsivejs/design (r$). The library itself now lives standalone at @responsivejs/* (github.com/AleSaiani/ResponsiveJS).

scripts.test: echo 'Contract tests run via `pnpm certify` (needs a dev server on the scenarios port).' && exit 0
scripts.test:certify: node tests/tooling/generate.ts && npx playwright test --config tests/playwright-ui.config.ts && npx playwright test --config tests/playwright-behavior.config.ts
